simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פָּצַח (H6476) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 9 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פָּצַח (pâtsach) means to break out (in joyful sound) First listed occurrence: Isa 14 7.

definitions.usage: break (forth, forth into joy), make a loud noise.
definitions.full: H6476. patsach מָּצַח verb cause to break or burst forth, break forth with (compare Arabic break, crush ; Ethiopic shatter ; Syriac is be joyous, hilarious ); — Qal Perfect 3plural רִנָּה מָּֽצְחוּ Isa 14:7 they have broken forth with joyous shout; Imperfect רִנָּה יִפְצְחוּ 55:12 (of mountains); Imperative feminine singular רִנָּה מִּצְחִי 54:1 (of Zion); masculine plural ר ׳מִּצְחוּ 44:23 ; 49:13 Qr (> Kt יפצחו ; of mountains); absolute מִּצְחוּ 52:9 ; Psa 98:4 (both + רַנְּנוּ ). Pi`el break bones in pieces: Perfect 3plural מִּצֵּ֑חוּ Micah 3:3 .
